Here is the front view:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/53cfc6fea4c8584d4ed0e478b5e166b6f777a2b3.png

And let’s not forget about a short clip showing off the new restaurant:

[previewyoutube=VO-ct6Rk4ig;full][/previewyoutube] 

That’s it for now. We hope you liked it and remember to share your opinion on Steam, Discord or here in the comments!

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1131517979947978775/1232972545318326302/Discord_banner_4.png?ex=662b66aa&is=662a152a&hm=2fa6d2fecfb5951ba8f98ae6badae381e53c4d934c5c361a845d7d6f30200604&

Best,
Restaurant Renovator Team
